September 23, 2026


# Introducing the next Surface Pro 12-inch and Surface Laptop 13-inch with Snapdragon X2 Plus: Greater performance that travels light


By


- [Brett Ostrum, Corporate Vice President, Surface](https://blogs.windows.com/devices/author/brettostrum/)


Today at Snapdragon Summit, we introduced the next Surface Pro 12-inch and Surface Laptop 13-inch, built on


the


Snapdragon X2 Plus


® processor


, alongside the new Surface Mouse with integrated haptic feedback


1


. Surface Pro 12-inch and Surface Laptop 13-inch are two of our most versatile


Surface devices, designed to deliver the performance and battery life people need in PCs they can comfortably carry all day.


This generation brings up to 18% more efficient battery performance


2


, over 60% faster graphics


3


, and 95% faster on-device AI4


— all in the same lightweight design.


## What


defines Surface


laptops?


Surface is hardware built to bring the best of Microsoft to life — Windows, Copilot, and Microsoft 365 experiences that make a PC feel more useful, more personal and more responsive.


That work starts long before the chip is finished. Surface engineers partner with Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. during silicon development to help make sure Snapdragon X2 is tuned for the realities of thin, light PCs: sustained performance, efficient power use, quiet thermals and responsive on-device AI.


It’s the innovation role Surface has always played: turning what’s possible in Windows into products people can hold, carry and use every day. We did it with touch, pen


5,


and haptics. We’re doing it now with AI on the PC. With Snapdragon X2 Series and Windows, you shouldn’t have to choose where that AI runs. Supported experiences can use the device, the cloud, or both, so you get lower latency, less dependence on cloud calls and tokens, and more privacy when your data stays with you.


The result is more than a processor upgrade. Compared to previous generations, Surface Pro 12-inch and Surface Laptop 13-inch with Snapdragon X2 Plus offer:


- Up to 17% faster in Office productivity workloads


6,7


- Up to 18% more efficient battery performance


8


- More than 60% faster graphics performance


2


,9


- Up to 95% faster local AI inferencing on the NPU


3


,


8


Peak numbers only tell part of the story. What matters is hour six — twenty tabs, a call running, something rendering — and the machine still calm and quiet in your hands.


## Surface Pro 12-inch: big ideas start here


Surface Pro 12-inch is the most portable


and versatile


Surface Pro we make — a thin, light and


fanless


Windows PC that moves from tablet to laptop as quickly as your day changes. Attach Surface Pro 12-inch Keyboard to write,


code


or respond to email


. P


ick up the magnetically stored Surface Slim Pen when an idea is easier to sketch than type.


5


With Snapdragon X2 Plus, Pro feels more responsive for everyday work like summarizing notes, editing photos and annotating designs


, and adds an extra hour of active web browsing


10


. A 25% brighter, 500-nit PixelSense


™


touchscreen and new Black color bring more clarity


and c


hoice


11


, while an enclosure made with 86% recycled content reflects the cr


aft


behind


a design built for wherever work


moves.


12


Surface Pro 12-inch starts at $1149.99 MSRP, available starting October 13 in select markets.


Surface Pro 12-inch introduces


[Microsoft I nk Canvas](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/surface/introducing-microsoft-ink-canvas) , an AI-powered, pen-first experience for sketching, annotating, generating images and summarizing text directly on the canvas. Built for the moments before an idea becomes a document or prompt, Ink Canvas lets customers use Slim Pen to express intent visually, spatially and in their own handwriting — giving


Copilot ri


cher context and helping rough thoughts become useful creations faster.


5


Ink Canvas


will be


pre-installed


on the new Pro 12-inch


, and will also be available to download from the Microsoft Store


on other supported Surface and Windows devices


on October


13.


13


## Surface Laptop 13-inch: think big, travel light


Surface Laptop 13-inch is the classic Surface laptop refined — a thin, light


Windows PC built around the details that


people notice every day


: a full-size backlit keyboard, precision touchpad, premium aluminum body and taller 3:2 PixelSense


™


touchscreen.14,16


Snapdragon X2 Plus keeps everyday experiences feeling smooth, whether you’re streaming a movie


or designing a presentation. With a 25% brighter, 500-nit display,


22.5 hours of battery life


15


and a new Black color


9


,


Surface Laptop


is designed to feel polished,


personal


and easy to carry every day.


Surface Laptop 13-inch starts at $


1,199


MSRP, available


starting


October 13th


in


select markets.


## Surface Mouse: feedback you can feel


We also introduced Surface Mouse, a new mouse designed to make everyday interactions feel more precise. Its haptic feedback adds a small, purposeful physical response to the moment you usually only see on a screen: a click registering, a window snapping into place or an object aligning just right. It is subtle by design, but noticeable within seconds — and hard to give up once you have it.


Surface Mouse brings a redesigned ambidextrous shape for comfortable all-day use, a customizable action button for Copilot


16


and everyday shortcuts, and Bluetooth 6.0 so you can pair with multiple devices and move between them easily. It’s also made with 30% recycled content, including the most post-consumer recycled plastic of any Surface mouse.17


Surface Mouse starts at $79.99 and will be available in Black and Platinum beginning October 13th in select markets


.


## Built for business, ready for AI


Surface Pro 12-inch, Surface Laptop 13-inch and Surface Mouse will also be available to commercial customers through Surface for Business beginning October 13. Pro 12-inch will also offer an optional 5G configuration


18


— one of the most requested additions to this form factor — helping mobile teams stay connected without relying on public Wi-Fi.


Across both PCs, Snapdragon X2 Plus gives organizations a consistent foundation for supported local AI experiences.


Security and manageability are built in from chip to cloud. Microsoft-designed protections include Secured-core PC safeguards, Microsoft Pluton with TPM 2.0, and Surface UEFI built with Secure Patina Core and Project Mu open-source components available through the Open Device Partnership. Surface Tools for Business — including Surface Management Portal, Surface Support Portal, Surface IT Toolkit and Surface Repair Tool — help IT teams manage, protect, support and recover devices throughout their lifecycle.


Together, these devices extend the Surface for Business lineup with thin, light Windows PCs and accessories built for mobility, AI and modern endpoint management.


## Find your next Surface at Microsoft Store


Choose


[Surface Pro 12-inch](https://aka.ms/pro12fall1) if you want one device that moves from tablet to laptop, with pen-first flexibility for notes, sketches and ideas in motion. Choose


[Surface Laptop 13-inch](https://aka.ms/laptop13fall1) if you want a thin, light touchscreen laptop with a full-size keyboard built for long days and long documents.


Visit Surface.com to explore the new Surface Laptop, 13-inch (2nd edition) and Surface Pro, 12-inch (2nd edition).


When you shop at


[Microsoft Store,](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/?icid=cmmiov4q3l6) you can get:


- Up to $400 in additional value with an eligible device trade-in


19


- Fast, free shipping and 60-day free returns


- Flexible payment and financing options


- Expert support from Microsoft


- A one-year limited hardware warranty


20


Surface has been shaped for more than a decade by the people who use it — architects, developers, students, creators and anyone turning an idea into something real. Together, Surface Pro 12-inch, Surface Laptop 13-inch and Surface Mouse carry that work forward with devices and accessories built for how people create, move and get things done today.
